transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. Before I sign it, I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule or readiness changes at our weekly training huddle. We've got the driver-certification block and radio-procedures refresher for support personnel to place, and the training yard is available Monday through Friday with driver-cert normally on Tuesday morning. What changes or issues do we need to account for?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. The tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, so it's not reflected in the current draft of the board.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to report a readiness change. During this morning's inspection I confirmed that only four of our six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two will not be released until Friday at 0800. This inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board, so the current draft doesn't reflect it. This directly impacts the driver-certification block — if we keep it on Tuesday morning, we'll only have four trucks available instead of six.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Update the battalion training tracker and briefing slide to reflect the Wednesday 1300-1500 radio-procedures refresher for 2nd Platoon, and submit the attendance roster afterward as required by higher headquarters.
Move the driver-certification block from Tuesday morning to Friday morning to ensure all six training trucks are available, and post the updated brake-inspection status to the training board.
Publish the updated sustainment-training board with the revised driver-certification and radio-refresher windows by 1600 today, signed by Maj. Patel.

transcript.speaker: A1
